title: chore(news): stop reddit posting and keep only its tone
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Removed daily and Sunday Reddit post and image generation, along with Reddit delivery, SSH key loading, its delivery state, and the Reddit-only Mon–Sat 15:00 workflow run. Delivery now sends only Discord; the Sunday 18:00 run still sends the weekly Discord post. Kept `prompts/tone/reddit.md` for a future agent and left older `reddit.json` files archived. Updated pipeline documentation and delivery tests; 33 tests pass, and practice runs produced unchanged text for every other post. The Reddit VPS secrets are now unused and can be deleted separately.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden shed, Polli wears a tiny filing-clerk visor and places a card labeled “Reddit tone” in an archive drawer while a single Discord message leaves a lime green (#ecf874) CRT terminal beside flowering code-plants. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings. She should be small-to-medium sized within the scene, sharing the frame with other elements — never oversized or dominating the image. Strictly pixel art style, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with a warm cream background and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
